messages:
emma: FYI I opened a mini PR to polish SDK examples for streaming + pagination + retries across Py/TS/Go. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4270. Goal: single-file runnable snippets (~8-12 lines) and a short migration callout for v1 next_cursor -> v2 resume_token. Can folks eyeball?

tariq: Ill take TS. Plan: compact async iterator that dedupes partial tokens and implements exponential backoff (3 retries). Keep helper inline.

ana: Ill do Python. Will show a generator wrapper around client.stream() and include an Expected output block.

cole: I updated the Go snippet to use a buffered channel and context cancellation, and showed where to persist ResumeToken after checkpoint. Small note in the PR about avoiding blocking sends in examples.

emma: One editorial note: use `resume_token` in prose and `ResumeToken` in code samples. Avoid multi-line lorem; use a tiny JSON payload like {"query":"summarize: two lines"}.

tariq: Pushed TS patch. Local snippet test passed (async iterator needed await fix).

ana: Py pushed. Included before/after migration: v1 `next_cursor` -> v2 `resume_token` with one-line curl examples.

cole: Go pushed and added comment about persistence. Kept example to 10 lines.

deploy-bot: CI: docs/lint , docs/build running (started at 3968009000)

emma: Quick checklist before merge: 1) expected-stdout present for each language, 2) snippets <=12 lines, 3) auto-linker anchors checked.

deploy-bot: CI: docs/build , examples/test-harness  (completed at 3968012000)

emma: Merged after tiny formatting tweaks to TS code block. Thanks team!
